title: The Letter S — S is for Shepherd
objective: Students will learn the letter S and its sound using the Bible word Shepherd.
content: Today we learn the letter S! The letter S makes the sound 'sss' like a snake. Can you say 'sss'?
A Shepherd takes care of sheep. The Bible says God is our Shepherd! Just like a shepherd keeps his sheep safe, God keeps us safe and loves us.
S is also in the words Sun, Star, and Song. Let's make the 'sss' sound together. S-S-Shepherd!
activity: Trace the letter S with your finger. Draw a picture of a shepherd with sheep. Find things that start with S.
discussion: What sound does the letter S make?
